form.label: AD Objects - AI - Assistant (NL to SPL)
form.description: Ask a question in plain English and get SUGGESTED SPL back for review. The suggestion is returned as text and is never executed by this app - read it, adjust it, and run it yourself. Works with AI disabled: you get a deterministic starter query built from this app's own macro and lookup vocabulary.

input.label: Your question (plain English, no double quotes)
input.default: which service accounts logged on interactively this week?
input.initialValue: which service accounts logged on interactively this week?

input.label: Generation mode
input.choice: Auto (use AI if enabled, else template)

search.query: | makeresults | eval question="$tok_question$" | adnl2spl question_field=question mode="$tok_mode$"

html.div: Review before running. The SPL below is a suggestion. This app returns it as a text field and never executes it - there is no auto-run, no drilldown that dispatches it, and no scheduled search that consumes it. Read it, confirm the indexes, sourcetypes and time range suit your environment, then run it yourself in the search bar. Generated SPL can be wrong, expensive, or both. Any suggestion containing a non-read-only command (outputlookup, delete, collect, sendemail, script, rest, ...) is rejected by the app and is never displayed.

search.query: eval Status=case(ai_status=="llm","Generated by model: ".ai_model,ai_status=="template","Template suggestion (AI disabled in ad_obj_ai.conf)",ai_status=="template_no_grounding","No question supplied",true(),"Template fallback (".ai_status.")") | eval "Suggested SPL (copy, review, then run yourself)"=replace(generated_spl,"\n"," ") | rename nl_question AS Question, spl_notes AS Notes | table Question,Status,"Suggested SPL (copy, review, then run yourself)",Notes

html.div: The SPL cell above is a single line so it can be selected and copied in one go. The multi-line, indented form is in the panel below.

panel.title: Suggested SPL - one pipeline segment per row

search.query: eval seg=split(replace(generated_spl,"\n"," "),"| ") | mvexpand seg | eval seg=trim(seg) | where seg!="" | streamstats count AS step | eval "Pipeline segment"=if(step=1 AND NOT match(replace(generated_spl,"\n"," "),"^\s*\|"),seg,"| ".seg) | table step,"Pipeline segment"

html.div: Reading the suggestion one command at a time is the review step. Nothing on this page runs it.

search.query: eval "Grounding sent to the model"=if(ai_grounding_fields="","(none - AI was not called)","your question only (field: ".ai_grounding_fields.")") | eval "Vocabulary offered as context"=replace(spl_vocabulary,",",", ") | rename ai_status AS "ai_status", ai_model AS "Model", ai_reason AS "Reason", ai_warning AS "Warning" | table "ai_status","Model","Reason","Grounding sent to the model","Vocabulary offered as context","Warning" | transpose 1 column_name="Item" | rename "row 1" AS Value

html.div: What is sent. For this panel the only grounding is your question plus this app's own macro / lookup vocabulary. No AD object data, no KV Store rows and no event data are sent. With AI disabled nothing leaves the instance at all.

panel.title: Model Risk Overview - Top Entities (useful with AI disabled)

search.query: | inputlookup AD_Obj_Risk | eval last_scored=tonumber(last_scored), first_seen=tonumber(first_seen), risk_score=tonumber(risk_score) | where isnotnull(last_scored) AND last_scored>=relative_time(now(),"$tok_lookback$") | stats max(risk_score) AS peak_risk_score, avg(risk_score) AS avg_risk_score, count AS risk_rows, dc(risk_type) AS distinct_risk_types, values(risk_type) AS risk_types, values(mitre_technique_id) AS mitre_technique_id, min(first_seen) AS first_seen, max(last_scored) AS last_scored by entity,entity_type,domain | eval peak_risk_score=round(peak_risk_score,4), avg_risk_score=round(avg_risk_score,4) | eval first_seen=strftime(first_seen,"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"), last_scored=strftime(last_scored,"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S") | table entity,entity_type,domain,peak_risk_score,avg_risk_score,risk_rows,distinct_risk_types,risk_types,mitre_technique_id,first_seen,last_scored | sort - peak_risk_score | head 25

html.div: Populated by the Phase 1 AD_Obj_ML_*_Apply / _Alert scheduled searches (they ship disabled). This panel makes the page useful with no AI configured at all. The full model view is AD Objects - ML - Risk Overview.

search.query: | rest /servicesNS/-/-/configs/conf-ad_obj_ai splunk_server=local count=0 | search title="ai" | eval "AI enabled"=if(enabled="1","yes","NO - deterministic template narratives only (ship default)") | eval "Provider"=provider | eval "Endpoint configured"=if(endpoint_url="","no (no network destination exists)","yes") | eval "Model"=if(model_name="","(none)",model_name) | eval "Audit logging"=if(audit_enabled="1","on - $SPLUNK_HOME/var/log/splunk/ad_obj_llm_audit.log","OFF") | eval "Credential source"="storage/passwords realm=".secret_realm." username=".secret_username." (no secret value is stored in any .conf file)" | eval "Grounding allowlist size"=mvcount(split(allowed_grounding_fields,","))." field(s) may enter a prompt" | table "AI enabled","Provider","Endpoint configured","Model","Audit logging","Credential source","Grounding allowlist size" | transpose 1 column_name="Setting" | rename "row 1" AS Value

html.div: The app ships with enabled = 0 and provider = none. Enablement steps, the capability grant (ad_obj_can_use_ai), credential setup via storage/passwords, and the audit-log monitor stanza are documented in README.txt, section "5.0.0 GenAI / LLM (Phase 2)". Running these panels requires the ad_obj_can_use_ai capability; without it the AI panels report an access-denied error and the risk panel above still works.
